name: Kashmiri Walnut Kernels
subtitle: A little crunch. A lot of character.
alt: Representative photograph of shelled walnut kernels in a bowl
description: Bring a rich, earthy crunch to your breakfast bowl, baking, or afternoon snack. Explore the walnut kernels featured on our Instagram and choose a pack that suits your kitchen.
storage: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening for longer storage.

name: Whole Cashews
subtitle: Creamy, crunchy, endlessly versatile.
alt: Representative stock photograph of cashews on a wooden board
description: From a simple handful to your favourite festive recipe, cashews make everyday moments a little more special. Select your pack size and ask Shakir about the varieties available today.
storage: Store sealed in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight and moisture.

name: Dried Figs · Anjeer
subtitle: Naturally sweet, beautifully simple.
alt: Representative stock photograph of dried figs in a white bowl
description: Soft, chewy anjeer with a delicate seeded texture. Enjoy with nuts, chop into porridge, or add to a thoughtful food gift. Select a pack for everyday snacking, baking, or sharing.
storage: Store airtight in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening, especially in warm or humid weather.
allergens: Packed alongside tree nuts. Ask about handling if you have a food allergy.

name: Kashmiri Saffron
subtitle: A few threads. A beautiful difference.
alt: Representative stock photograph of saffron threads on a wooden spoon
description: Discover the saffron threads featured in our collection. Infuse a few threads in warm milk or water before adding to rice, desserts, or a comforting cup of kahwa. Ask Shakir for current batch details before ordering.
storage: Store in an airtight container, away from heat, moisture, and direct light.
allergens: Ask about packing and cross-contact if you have a food allergy.

subtitle: Your daily handful of goodness.
